definitions.explanation: A team game in which players throw small balls into a tall basket, common at Japanese school sports festivals.

examples.japanese: {運動会|うんどうかい}で{玉|たま}{入|い}れをした。
examples.english: We played the ball-toss game at the sports festival.

examples.japanese: {玉|たま}{入|い}れの{玉|たま}をかごに{投|な}げ{入|い}れる。
examples.english: You throw the balls into the basket in the ball-toss game.

examples.japanese: {玉|たま}{入|い}れは{紅白|こうはく}に{分|わ}かれて、かごに{入|はい}った{玉|たま}の{数|かず}を{競|きそ}う{競技|きょうぎ}だ。
examples.english: Tama-ire is a contest where teams split into red and white and compete over how many balls land in the basket.

notes:
A team game played at school {運動会|うんどうかい} (sports festivals): players toss small balls into a tall basket, and the team with more balls in the basket wins.

HOW IT WORKS:
- {玉|たま} (balls) are thrown into a raised かご (basket).
- Teams are usually split into {紅白|こうはく} (red and white).
- The balls are counted aloud at the end to decide the winner.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {玉|たま}{入|い}れをする: to play the ball-toss game
- {玉|たま}をかごに{入|い}れる: to get balls into the basket
